name: instagram-archiver-wacz-packager
description: Node helper for har_to_wacz.py: packages a WARC into a WACZ via js-wacz (warcio.js). Uses the SAME toolchain replayweb.page/wabac uses at replay, so CDX keys (SURT trailing slash, POST __wb_method + decodeURI-encoded body) match at lookup time. py-wacz (Python surt + cdxj_indexer) canonicalizes differently and its POST keys never match wabac, breaking POST/GraphQL replay.
